environment: Isolated compatibility fixture; real DOM/WebGL/WebAudio; mocked API, speech services and native IPC

checks.name: original WebGL shader compiles and renders
main chat mounts without acquiring microphone
desktop chat is within viewport
keyboard opens call dialog without automatic recording
all five original themes switch without recreating GPU programs
orb animation does not rerender React at frame rate
explicit call action starts capture and live listening state
microphone mute releases capture; unmute resumes without sending partial text
captions track the turn; speaking starts only on actual playback event
tap-to-interrupt cancels output and starts a new listening turn
hang-up closes call and cannot restart microphone
stop cancels main chat and rejects late callbacks while preserving draft
tool picker does not invent unavailable backend tools
IME Enter does not accidentally submit a message
closing pending microphone permission releases the eventual stream
mobile chat keeps composer on screen without horizontal overflow
mobile call controls remain reachable with transcript open
Escape closes native dialog and restores focus
reduced motion freezes animation while preserving theme updates
hidden tabs pause the graphics loop
WebGL context loss shows fallback and restores original shader
unmount releases all created WebGL programs
WebGL unavailable retains visible keyboard-operable fallback
native companion starts compact with transparent background
companion expands through typed native resize command
pin, focus-main, drag and keyboard movement invoke native controls
native hidden-window notification ends call and releases microphone
compact close invokes native hide instead of destroying state
unsupported native recognition is honest and text chat still works
real WebAudio energy drives vibration; silence settles without React frame updates
no uncaught browser exceptions across tested screens
